mapper.select:
SELECT io.id, io.inbound_order_no AS inboundOrderNo, io.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, io.inbound_type AS inboundType, io.inbound_status AS status,
COALESCE(item_summary.plan_qty, 0) AS planQty, COALESCE(item_summary.received_qty, 0) AS receivedQty, COALESCE(item_summary.putaway_qty, 0) AS putawayQty,
u.real_name AS creatorName,
io.gmt_create AS createdTime, io.gmt_modified AS updatedTime, io.remark
FROM inbound_order io
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = io.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN wms_user u ON u.id = io.created_by
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inbound_order_id, SUM(plan_qty) AS plan_qty, SUM(received_qty) AS received_qty, SUM(putaway_qty) AS putaway_qty FROM inbound_order_item GROUP BY inbound_order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.inbound_order_id = io.id
ORDER BY io.gmt_create DESC, io.id DESC
